verses.pali: “Sabbaṁ, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṁ aparijānaṁ avirājayaṁ appajahaṁ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
verses.english: “Mendicants, without directly knowing and completely understanding the all, without dispassion for it and giving it up, you can’t end suffering.

verses.pali: Kiñca, bhikkhave, sabbaṁ anabhijānaṁ aparijānaṁ avirājayaṁ appajahaṁ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya?
verses.english: And what is the all, without directly knowing and completely understanding which, without dispassion for it and giving it up, you can’t end suffering?

verses.pali: Yañca, bhikkhave, cakkhu, ye ca rūpā, yañca cakkhuviññāṇaṁ, ye ca cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā …pe…
verses.english: The eye, sights, eye consciousness, and things knowable by eye consciousness.

verses.pali: yā ca jivhā, ye ca rasā, yañca jivhāviññāṇaṁ, ye ca jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā;
yo ca kāyo, ye ca phoṭṭhabbā, yañca kāyaviññāṇaṁ, ye ca kāyaviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā;
yo ca mano, ye ca dhammā, yañca manoviññāṇaṁ, ye ca manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā—
verses.english: The mind, ideas, mind consciousness, and things knowable by mind consciousness.

verses.pali: idaṁ kho, bhikkhave, sabbaṁ anabhijānaṁ aparijānaṁ avirājayaṁ appajahaṁ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
verses.english: This is the all, without directly knowing and completely understanding which, without dispassion for it and giving it up, you can’t end suffering.

verses.pali: Sabbaṁ, bhikkhave, abhijānaṁ parijānaṁ virājayaṁ pajahaṁ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
verses.english: By directly knowing and completely understanding the all, having dispassion for it and giving it up, you can end suffering.

verses.pali: Kiñca, bhikkhave, sabbaṁ abhijānaṁ parijānaṁ virājayaṁ pajahaṁ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāya?
verses.english: And what is the all, directly knowing and completely understanding which, having dispassion for it and giving it up, you can end suffering?

verses.pali: Yañca, bhikkhave, cakkhu, ye ca rūpā, yañca cakkhuviññāṇaṁ, ye ca cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā …pe…
verses.english: The eye, sights, eye consciousness, and things knowable by eye consciousness.

verses.pali: yā ca jivhā, ye ca rasā, yañca jivhāviññāṇaṁ, ye ca jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā;
yo ca kāyo, ye ca phoṭṭhabbā, yañca kāyaviññāṇaṁ, ye ca kāyaviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā;
yo ca mano, ye ca dhammā, yañca manoviññāṇaṁ, ye ca manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā—
verses.english: The mind, ideas, mind consciousness, and things knowable by mind consciousness.

verses.pali: idaṁ kho, bhikkhave, sabbaṁ abhijānaṁ parijānaṁ virājayaṁ pajahaṁ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā”ti.
verses.english: This is the all, directly knowing and completely understanding which, having dispassion for it and giving it up, you can end suffering.”
